text.p: Vornado Realty LP, a 90.4 percent owned partnership of Vornado Realty Trust, on Thursday filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for $1.614 billion in debt and depositary shares.

When combined with a previous registration, Vornado said it will have a total offering of $1.75 billion in shares available for sale. Of the the total amount, $750 million will be offered as depositary shares and $1 billion as debt.
The shelf could translate to common shares, preferred shares or some variation of preferred shares, according to the company. An offering is not planned in the near-term, it said.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
Vornado, based in Saddle Brook, N.J., is an UPREIT, or real estate investment trust that contributes its assets up into an operating partnership.
